title: Self-Pay Terms: Refund Amount on a Missed In-Person Appointments Visit
content:
**Clause 1, deposit held.** The deposit held on a missed In-Person Appointments visit is the total of the deposits collected on it less the total already released from it, as the entries in its fee and deposit history show.

**Clause 2, fee the refund offsets.** The no-show fee the refund offsets is the visit type's no-show fee when the visit's status is no-show, and nothing otherwise. That fee is reckoned in one order: the visit type's no-show fee is raised first; sums added to or taken off the fee then apply to that figure; a reduction by a percentage is applied to the figure so reached; and the fee is rounded to the cent only at the end.

**Clause 3, refund.** The refund on the missed visit is the deposit held on it, less the no-show fee the refund offsets, plus the amount recorded on it as waived for its no-show fee, rounded to the cent. The amount recorded as waived is the total of the waiver entries for the no-show fee in the missed visit's fee and deposit history, and nothing where there is none.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A self-pay patient misses an Advanced Imaging Appointment, visit type no-show fee $150.00. Deposits collected on the visit total $250.00 and nothing has been released, so the deposit held is $250.00. The no-show fee the refund offsets is $150.00.

| Waiver entries for the no-show fee | Refund |
|---|---|
| none | 250.00 less 150.00, plus 0.00: $100.00 |
| one entry of $150.00 | 250.00 less 150.00, plus 150.00: $250.00 |

**Further hypothetical.** Deposits collected of $200.00 with $50.00 already released leave $150.00 held; the refund is worked from $150.00, not from the $200.00 collected.
